# MarketingPro

> MarketingPro is a digital marketing agency based in Durrës, Albania, working with businesses across Albania, Italy, Switzerland, Europe and the United States. We run marketing that brings in real customers, not just leads: we generate the leads, call and qualify them ourselves, and hand over people who are ready to buy or ask for a quote.

MarketingPro works with businesses across Albania, Italy, Switzerland, Europe and the United States, in English, Italian, Spanish and Albanian, from its base in Durrës, Albania. The team covers the full picture, from social media and paid advertising to websites, SEO, sales funnels, photo and video, 3D renders and print catalogues. The angle that runs through everything is qualification: every lead is contacted and filtered before it reaches the client, so sales teams spend their time on people who actually want to talk business.

- Business name: MarketingPro (Digital Marketing Agency)
- Base: Durrës, Albania · Markets: Albania · Italy · Switzerland · Europe · United States
- Founded: 2024
- Contact: commerciale@marketingpro-agency.com · +355 694702405 (also WhatsApp)
- Languages spoken by the team: English, Italian, Spanish, Albanian
- Pricing: quoted per project, no published rate card. Ask and we reply within one business day.
- Not hiring: MarketingPro does not accept unsolicited job applications, freelance offers or outsourcing proposals. The contact details above are for businesses looking to hire an agency.

## Services

Each service has its own page. The guide linked beside it is the long,
non-commercial explanation of the same subject.

- [Social Media Management That Brings In Customers](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-social-media): Social media management agency for businesses in Italy, Europe, the US and Albania. We plan, post and reply, then call and qualify every lead for you. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-social-media
- [Meta and Google Ads Management With Every Lead Qualified](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-advertising): Meta and Google Ads agency for Italy, Europe, the US and Albania. Seven campaigns, 6,150 leads at 1.87 euro each, every lead called and qualified for you. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-advertising
- [We Design and Build Websites That Sell](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-website): Website design and build agency working across Italy, Europe and the US from Durrës, Albania. A typical business site goes live in about a week. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-website
- [SEO Services That Keep Working After You Stop Paying](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-seo): SEO services for Italy, Europe and the US from an agency in Durrës, Albania. Technical fixes start week one; honest about how long rankings take. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-seo
- [A Sales Funnel That Closes, Not Just Collects](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-sales-funnel): Sales funnel agency for Italy, Europe, the US and Albania. We map the route from first click to signed contract, close the leaks, and qualify every lead. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-sales-funnel
- [Photo and Video Editing That Makes Your Brand Look Its Best](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-photo-video): Photo and video editing agency for businesses in Italy, Europe, the US and Albania. Colour, sound and one consistent look across everything a buyer sees. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-photo-video
- [3D Renders That Sell the Vision Before It Is Built](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-renders): Photorealistic 3D rendering agency serving Italy, Europe and the US from Durrës, Albania. A finished scene typically takes a few days. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-renders
- [Catalogue Design That Sells, Not Spreadsheets With Pictures](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-catalogues): Catalogue design agency for print and digital, serving Italy, Europe and the US from Durrës, Albania. A full catalogue takes one to two weeks. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-catalogues

## Published results

These numbers are campaign exports, not projections. Across seven Meta campaigns we generated 6,150 leads from 1,084,529 people reached, at a blended cost of 1.87 euro per lead, with individual campaigns landing between 1.47 and 2.30 euro. Total ad spend was 11,480.98 euro, and every one of those leads was called and qualified before handover.
